West Indies Defeat India in T20 Series Decider

West Indies defeated India by 24 runs to tie the T20 series 2-2. Shai Hope scored an unbeaten century, reaching the landmark with a six off the final ball, as West Indies posted a total of 247 for three. Keemo Paul took five wickets for West Indies.
